ui.bone_trader.title: Bone Trader
ui.bone_trader.source: You can earn bones as you progress through the world by killing Skeletimps and Megaskeletimps.
ui.bone_trader.flavor: The Bone Trader trades bones for... bonuses
ui.bone_trader.exotic_imports_desc_prefi: Exotic Imp-orts will be unlocked permanently once purchased. Each has a
ui.bone_trader.exotic_imports_desc_suffi: chance to spawn per cell and better loot than normal enemies. Any stacking multipliers from killing Imp-orts reset on Portal but the imps do not have to be unlocked again.
ui.bone_trader.bone_portal_desc: Automatically gain helium equal to the amount you earned on your best run
ui.bone_trader.heirloom_desc: Get one Heirloom at the chances above, based on highest zone
